scope: Frozen baseline K rows plus the complete re-review of the frozen baseline non-K rows; no current/v60 rows are included.

hit_at_1_full.reason: One deduplicated expected-round unit per expected and round; denominator is 145 x 3

hit_at_3_full.unit: unique expected IDs hit in any of 3 rounds

hit_at_all_full.unit: unique expected IDs hit in all 3 rounds

l2_hit_at_1_full.unit: L2 expected-round units across all 3 rounds
l2_hit_at_1_full.reason: One deduplicated L2 expected-round unit per expected and round; denominator is 39 x 3

l2_hit_at_3_full.unit: unique L2 expected IDs hit in any round

l2_hit_at_all_full.unit: unique L2 expected IDs hit in all rounds

supported_coverage_round_units.unit: expected-round units with FULL or PARTIAL

supported_coverage_unique_expected.unit: unique expected IDs with FULL or PARTIAL

partial_only_known_report.reason: K reports with PARTIAL and no FULL

partial_only_known_expected.reason: PARTIAL-only expected IDs after FULL subtraction

report_based_precision.reason: Valid K or N reports divided by all reports

report_based_fp_rate.reason: Invalid I reports divided by all reports

ledger_group_based_precision.unit: unique K expected hit + substantive N groups + invalid diagnostic clusters
ledger_group_based_precision.reason: Valid K expected hits plus substantive N groups divided by the grouped publication composition; I clusters are invalid diagnostics

ledger_group_based_fp_rate.unit: unique K expected hit + substantive N groups + invalid diagnostic clusters
ledger_group_based_fp_rate.reason: Invalid diagnostic-cluster share of grouped composition

ledger_group_sensitivity_unmerged_I.unit: unique K expected hit + substantive N groups + raw I reports
ledger_group_sensitivity_unmerged_I.reason: Sensitivity when invalid reports are not diagnostically merged

w2_all_expected.reason: Only original baseline W2 receipts qualify; duplicate reports for one expected-round unit do not increase the numerator and post-hoc Judging cannot upgrade W

l2_ledger_based.reason: N/I groups have no natural L2 expected attribution; the baseline layer does not manufacture an L2 ledger precision or FP denominator.

predicate_usage.reason: X1v2 baseline has no current-side predicate binding schema; not_applicable is not zero.
